bootstrap.method: Whole games sampled with replacement within old/new holdout strata; fixed stratum sizes; identical draws across all four models; ratios of summed counts.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile; pointwise, not simultaneous across actions or random seeds.

limitations: All four fixed endpoints are retained; no seed/checkpoint selection.
A passed screen authorizes considering a separate expanded experiment; it neither deploys nor satisfies the user target.
Undefined denominators yield null bounds and valid-replicate counts, not zero-valued performance.
Insufficient fit/holdout or precision-comparison support blocks screen passage.
The source-stratified bootstrap preserves selected source proportions; it does not estimate source-shift or seed-distribution uncertainty.
